title: exceltoxml action
description: Converts an xlsx workbook (not the older xls) into XML: <workbook> holds an element per rule, named after the rule's name, else its worksheet, with a <row> per row of the rule's cells and an element per cell (field1, field2, ... or the header names). Values only: strings and numbers; dates come as Excel's serial numbers.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: JSON list of rules: {"name": "node1", "worksheet": "Sheet1", "cellRange": "A2:C4", "transpose": false, "headerRow": false, "discardEmpty": false}. An empty worksheet is the first, an empty cellRange the whole used range; headerRow takes the first row as field names; discardEmpty leaves out empty cells and rows. A flow's DIL rules list is passed as this text
